motionReference: Analytic upright joint reference + fixed world foot anchors + COM transfer; no T2M or learned policy
controlMechanism: 50 Hz bounded joint torques; unactuated floating root; no applied external forces

scene.name: Gakucho measured-body nominal flat-floor 1 m walking baseline

display.restPose: T-pose aligned by existing bindCharacterToSource to DEFAULT_BVH

measurement.method: skinned foot/toe descendant weights >= 0.5; vertices at or below ankle + 0.025 m
skinned foot/toe descendant weights >= 0.5; vertices at or below ankle + 0.025 m
head descendant weights >= 0.5 plus attached hair; vertices at or above head bone - 0.08 m; sphere encloses measured AABB on each principal axis
X-axis capsule: measured seated pelvis width/depth and lowest rendered pelvis vertex; circular Y/Z simplification

calibration.method: existing Three GLTFLoader + loadCharacterModel + bindCharacterToSource; all dimensions from deformed mesh and world bones
calibration.normalizedHeightConvention: room-prototype normalized 1.8 m height; DEFAULT_BVH directions and rest alignment

pelvisSkin.method: actual rendered vertices with direct pelvis skin weight >= 0.35; rest-pose envelope, not a measured seated cushion compression

seatedCalibration.pose: geometric 90-degree hip and knee seat pose: thighs forward, shanks down; no root translation
seatedCalibration.note: contact geometry calibration only; not a learned seated behavior or soft-tissue measurement

calibration.dynamicAssumptions: 64.7 kg distribution and 20-hinge torque/joint bounds remain existing simplified physics assumptions

metrics.scope: one nominal flat-floor 1 m test, seed 0, randomize=False; 30 second rollout including post-arrival hold; not RL or generic-room validation
